cohort: 1321 women pregnant or who gave birth during the COVID-19 pandemic
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic negatively impacted the mental health of pregnant women, who expressed significant concerns about isolation from their child, childbirth without a companion, and risk of infection in the hospital.
mod_finding: There was no difference between the rate of childbirth via cesarean sections over vaginal delivery during the 'first wave' of the pandemic.
